class.name: BulletVolley2D
class.brief_description: One volley of bullets: everything one spawn call created, drawn by one multimesh and moved together. Spawn it with [method BulletFactory2D.spawn_volley] (or a [BulletSpawner2D]), never with [code]new()[/code].
class.description:
One live volley: every bullet of one spawn call, drawn by a single multimesh and collided by one physics area. Each bullet flies along its own transform's rotation with its own speed. The volley holds everything the bullets need at runtime (per-bullet motion, collision shapes, attachments, curves, movement patterns, wobble, gravity, bounce, timers, animation, effect trails) plus advanced homing and orbiting. Keep the instance returned by [method BulletFactory2D.spawn_volley] to steer the bullets live; when the last bullet dies the volley returns to the factory's object pool and may be handed out again by a later spawn. It supports per-bullet homing deques for individualized target chasing (e.g., specific enemies) and a shared deque for uniform swarm behaviors (e.g., collective waypoint following). Targets can be global positions, Node2D instances, or mouse position, with optional auto-pop on reach (see [member bullet_homing_auto_pop_after_target_reached], [member shared_homing_deque_auto_pop_after_target_reached], [signal bullet_homing_target_reached]), smoothing for natural turning (see [member homing_smoothing]), distance before reached - [member homing_distance_before_reached] and update time interval (see [member homing_update_interval]). Enables complex bullet patterns in 2D games.
Warning: Never use [code]get_tree().create_timer()[/code] or any other godot timers with this class. It will cause issues with the internal timing of the bullets. If you need timers, use [method attach_time_based_function] instead.
Warning: Every signal fires live inside the physics tick (hits, bounces, lifetime, homing reached, animation finished), with the bullet still alive and every runtime property readable; per-bullet edits and spawning apply immediately from any handler. Only structural factory calls ([method BulletFactory2D.reset], [method BulletFactory2D.free_active_bullets], [method BulletFactory2D.free_disabled_bullets], [method BulletFactory2D.free_bullets_pool], [method BulletFactory2D.populate_bullets_pool], a collision-shape change) are rejected inside the tick: use their [code]*_deferred[/code] twins (for example [method BulletFactory2D.reset_deferred], [method set_collision_shape_runtime_deferred]), which run on the factory's idle queue. A plain [method Object.call_deferred] is not enough, because calls deferred from the physics step still run inside it.
Note: A volley's life: it is ACTIVE while any bullet flies. When its last bullet is disabled it returns to the pool ([method is_pooled], the handle is stale) if [member is_auto_pooling_enabled] is on, or it PARKS ([method is_parked]: frozen, still yours, wakeable with [method enable_bullet]) when it is off. [method disable_bullet] freezes a bullet with its state; [method bullet_reset_state] clears it. [method get_life_id] tells two lives of the same instance apart.
Warning: Homing functionality can be done in two ways - either using [b]per-bullet homing deques[/b] (each bullet has its own deque of homing targets) or a [b]shared homing deque[/b] (broadcast fallback for bullets without their own targets). Both are supported and per-bullet deques always win per bullet: a bullet with its own non-empty deque follows it, otherwise it follows the shared deque. If a per-bullet deque drains mid-flight the bullet falls back to the shared deque. Any method or property that mentions "shared" is related to the shared deque.
Note: Deque means double ended queue (you can push and pop from both ends), the homing target at the front is always the one being followed.
Note: Bullets can orbit around their current homing target if enabled (see [method bullet_enable_orbiting], [method all_bullets_enable_orbiting]). Orbiting requires having a valid homing target to orbit around. Be aware that orbiting does not care about the difference between a shared homing deque or a per bullet deque, as long as there is a target to orbit around it will work.
Note: Feature mixing has a fixed precedence each tick: homing steers the direction (per-bullet deque wins per bullet, shared is the fallback), direction curves adjust it (per-bullet channels win per channel, shared covers the rest), rotation spins only the visual, adjust_direction_based_on_rotation feeds the visual back into ballistics (skipped when rotate_only_textures is on, since that spin is rendering-only), movement patterns steer the displacement (per-bullet patterns win per bullet, shared is the fallback; skipped while a locked orbit owns the bullet, so non-repeating patterns never finish invisibly on the ring), and a locked orbit owns the final displacement. Homing smoothing has no effect while a movement pattern or rotation data drives the direction (the direction snaps instead). Teleporting a locked bullet re-aims its ring slot from the new position instead of snapping back. [method get_bullet_velocity] reports the logical velocity (direction times speed plus wind), excluding pattern and orbit displacement.
Note: Instead of [BulletSpeedData2D] with [method set_bullet_speed_data] you can take advantage of [BulletCurvesData2D] by using [method bullet_set_curves_data], [method all_bullets_set_curves_data] or [member shared_bullet_curves_data] if you want a shared curve for all bullets.
Note: For [Path2D] drawn bullet patterns try using [method set_bullet_movement_pattern_from_path] or [method set_bullet_movement_pattern_from_curve].
Note: For bullet attachments (particles, lights, etc...) use [BulletAttachment2D] and attach them via [method bullet_set_attachment] or [method all_bullets_set_attachment].
Note: For initial velocity/inertia use [member inherited_velocity_offset].
Note: For custom data that the multimesh should carry use [member shared_bullets_custom_data] - used for damage or anything else custom that is available in collision callbacks inside [BulletFactory2D].
Note: For object pooling options see [member is_auto_pooling_enabled] and [member is_attachments_auto_pooling_enabled].
Note: Bullets can be made to collide multiple times - use [member bullet_max_collision_count] and [member bullets_current_collision_count].
Note: Bullets animate via SpriteFrames. Switch with [method play_sprite_animation].

method.name: all_bullets_assign_homing_targets_array
method.description: Pushes one homing target per bullet: array element i goes to bullet (start + i), pushed to the back of its per-bullet deque. The array size must match the range size, and every element must be a Node2D or Vector2, otherwise nothing is pushed. Useful for scatter-to-enemies spreads.

method.name: all_bullets_clear_curves_data
method.description: Clears per-bullet curves over a range (default all) back to the shared fallback (or no curves when unset), mirroring [method clear_per_bullet_homing_smoothing]. Example: [code]bullets.all_bullets_clear_curves_data(); print(bullets.debug_get_curves_info(0)["speed_src"])[/code] prints "shared" or "none".

method.name: all_bullets_clear_homing_targets
method.description:
Clears all homing targets for the specified range of bullets (per-bullet deques only; shared deque unaffected).
If you want to clear all bullet targets for a shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_clear_homing_targets] instead.

method.name: all_bullets_disable_orbiting
method.description: Disables orbiting for the specified range of bullets.

method.name: all_bullets_enable_orbiting
method.description:
Enables orbiting for the specified range of bullets with the given parameters.
Note that orbiting relies on having a homing target to orbit around.

method.name: all_bullets_enable_orbiting_linear
method.description: Enables orbiting with concentric radii: bullet (start + k) orbits at radius_start + radius_step * k. Useful for shield rings. Bullets that already orbit keep their radius with a warning.

method.name: all_bullets_get_attachments
method.description: Get the attachments of all bullets in the specified range. Returns an array of [BulletAttachment2D], which can be null if a bullet doesn't have an attachment.

method.name: all_bullets_get_bounce_count
method.description: Bounce counts over a bullet range (mirrors [method bullet_get_bounce_count]). Inverted ranges are rejected.

method.name: all_bullets_get_curves_data
method.description: Get the curves data of all bullets in the specified range. Returns an array of [BulletCurvesData2D], which can be null if a bullet doesn't have curves data assigned.

method.name: all_bullets_get_custom_data
method.description: Get the per-bullet custom data of all bullets in the specified range. Returns an array of [Resource], null where a bullet has none set. Strictly separate from [member shared_bullets_custom_data].

method.name: all_bullets_get_direction
method.description: Get the direction of all bullets in the specified range. Returns an array of [Vector2] directions.

method.name: all_bullets_get_fall_speed
method.description: Integrated fall-speed magnitudes over a range (0 where gravity never integrated).

method.name: all_bullets_get_gravity
method.description: Per-bullet gravity vectors over a range.

method.name: all_bullets_get_homing_smoothing
method.description: Effective per-bullet homing smoothing over a range (per-bullet value where set, else shared).

method.name: all_bullets_get_homing_targets_amount
method.description: Returns the per-bullet homing queue depth of each bullet in the range (shared deque excluded; read it via [method shared_homing_deque_check_homing_targets_amount]). Example: after [method all_bullets_push_back_homing_target], depths are 1 per bullet.

method.name: all_bullets_get_orbiting_angle
method.description: Returns the locked ring angle (radians) of each bullet in the range. Same per-bullet warnings as [method bullet_get_orbiting_angle].

method.name: all_bullets_get_orbiting_center
method.description: Returns the orbit center of each bullet in the range: the locked ring point once locked, else the live deque front (per-bullet deque wins, shared is the fallback). Same per-bullet warnings as [method bullet_get_orbiting_center]. Example: [code]var centers = bullets.all_bullets_get_orbiting_center()[/code].

method.name: all_bullets_get_orbiting_radius
method.description: Returns the orbiting radius of all bullets in the range.

method.name: all_bullets_get_rotation_data
method.description: Rotation triples over a range (live values, mirrors [method all_bullets_get_speed_data]).

method.name: all_bullets_get_speed_data
method.description: Get the speed data of all bullets in the specified range. Returns an array of [BulletSpeedData2D].

method.name: all_bullets_get_texture_rotation_degrees
method.description: Get the texture rotation in degrees of all bullets in the specified range. Returns an array of floats representing the rotation in degrees.

method.name: all_bullets_get_texture_rotation_radians
method.description: Get the texture rotation in radians of all bullets in the specified range. Returns an array of floats representing the rotation in radians.

method.name: all_bullets_get_transforms
method.description: Get the transforms of all bullets in the specified range. Returns an array of [Transform2D].

method.name: all_bullets_get_velocity
method.description: Returns the logical velocities of all bullets in the range (direction x speed + inherited offset), excluding per-tick pattern/orbit displacement. Pair with [method BulletFactory2D.helper_generate_transforms_fan] for split patterns.

method.name: all_bullets_get_wobble_data
method.description: Per-bullet wobble resources over a range (null where the slot runs on the shared fallback or is inactive).

method.name: all_bullets_is_orbiting_enabled
method.description: Returns whether orbiting is enabled for each bullet in the range.

method.name: all_bullets_is_orbiting_locked
method.description: Returns whether each bullet in the range is currently locked onto its orbit ring (as opposed to merely enabled but still flying to the ring).

method.name: all_bullets_pop_back_target
method.description:
Pops a homing target from the back of the deque for all bullets in the range (per-bullet deques only).
Returns an array of popped targets.

method.name: all_bullets_pop_front_target
method.description:
Pops a homing target from the front of the deque for all bullets in the range (per-bullet deques only).
Returns an array of popped targets.

method.name: all_bullets_push_back_homing_target
method.description:
This is a helper that allows you to push a single homing target(Node2D or Vector2 global position) to the back of the deque for all bullets in the range (per-bullet deques only).
If you want to push back a target to the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_push_back_global_position_target], [method shared_homing_deque_push_back_node2d_target] or [method shared_homing_deque_push_back_mouse_position_target] instead.

method.name: all_bullets_push_back_homing_targets_array
method.description:
Pushes an array of homing targets (mix of Node2D and Vector2) to the back of the deque for all bullets in the range (per-bullet deques only).
If you want to push back targets to the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_push_back_homing_targets_array] instead.

method.name: all_bullets_push_back_mouse_position_target
method.description:
Pushes the current mouse global position as a homing target to the back of the deque for all bullets in the range (per-bullet deques only).
If you want to push back a mouse position target to the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_push_back_mouse_position_target] instead.

method.name: all_bullets_push_front_homing_target
method.description:
Pushes a single homing target (Node2D or Vector2 global position) to the front of the deque for all bullets in the range (per-bullet deques only).
Warning: Pushing to the front changes the current target being followed immediately.
If you want to push front a target to the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_push_front_global_position_target], [method shared_homing_deque_push_front_node2d_target] or [method shared_homing_deque_push_front_mouse_position_target] instead.

method.name: all_bullets_push_front_homing_targets_array
method.description:
Pushes an array of homing targets to the front of the deque for all bullets in the range (per-bullet deques only).
Warning: Pushing to the front changes the current target being followed immediately.
If you want to push front targets to the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_push_front_homing_targets_array] instead.

method.name: all_bullets_push_front_mouse_position_target
method.description:
Pushes the current mouse global position to the front of the deque for all bullets in the range (per-bullet deques only).
Warning: Pushing to the front changes the current target being followed immediately.
If you want to push front a mouse position target to the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_push_front_mouse_position_target] instead.

method.name: all_bullets_remove_movement_pattern
method.description: Removes the movement pattern from all bullets in the specified range, making them lose any [Path2D] or [Curve2D] drawn pattern they had and move solely based on their direction and speed data.

method.name: all_bullets_replace_homing_targets_with_mouse
method.description: Each homing target gets cleared and replaced with the Mouse as the target for all bullets in the range (per-bullet deques only). Locked orbit rings follow the lock policy ([method bullet_set_orbiting_lock_policy]); explicit clears still always unlock unless the policy is StayLocked.

method.name: all_bullets_replace_homing_targets_with_new_target
method.description:
Clears then pushes a single homing target to the back for all bullets in the range (per-bullet deques only). Locked orbit rings are kept or re-acquired per the lock policy instead of always dropping: same target keeps angle and center, a different target re-locks.
If you want to clear then push a single target to the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_replace_homing_targets_with_new_target] instead.

method.name: all_bullets_replace_homing_targets_with_new_target_array
method.description:
Clears then pushes an array of homing targets to the back for all bullets in the range (per-bullet deques only). Locked orbit rings are kept or re-acquired per the lock policy ([method bullet_set_orbiting_lock_policy]).
If you want to clear then push an array of targets to the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_replace_homing_targets_with_new_target_array] instead.

method.name: all_bullets_reset_state
method.description: [method bullet_reset_state] for every bullet in the range ([code](0, -1)[/code] = the whole volley).

method.name: all_bullets_set_attachment
method.description: Spawns the same attachment to all bullets in the specified range. An attachment is a [BulletAttachment2D] that can contain a [Node2D] with particles, lights, etc... that will be attached to the bullet and follow it around. You can use the [BulletAttachment2D] properties to control how the attachment behaves and is positioned relative to the bullet. Pooling is keyed by the scene itself, so every loader of the same scene shares one pool bucket.

method.name: all_bullets_set_attachment_to_null
method.description:
Removes the attachments of all bullets in the specified range by setting them to null. Returns an array of the removed [BulletAttachment2D] attachments, which can be useful if you want to reuse them as they are not freed, just detached from the bullets.
Warning: You have to take care of the returned attachments yourself.

method.name: all_bullets_set_curves_data
method.description: Sets the same curves data to all bullets in the specified range. Curves data is a [BulletCurvesData2D] resource that can contain multiple curves used to control different aspects of the bullet's behavior over time, such as movement speed, rotation speed, direction adjustment, etc...

method.name: all_bullets_set_custom_data
method.description: Sets the same custom data to all bullets in the specified range. Pass null to clear the per-bullet values (they read as null afterwards, never as the shared value).

method.name: all_bullets_set_direction
method.description: Sets the direction of all bullets in the specified range to a new direction. The direction gets normalized automatically.

method.name: all_bullets_set_direction_towards_node2d
method.description: Sets the direction of all bullets in the specified range towards a target [Node2D]. The direction gets normalized automatically.

method.name: all_bullets_set_direction_towards_position
method.description: Sets the direction of all bullets in the specified range towards a target global position. The direction gets normalized automatically.

method.name: all_bullets_set_gravity
method.description: Sets the gravity acceleration for a bullet range (default all), restarting each touched fall speed. Each slot behaves like [method bullet_set_gravity] and claims presence, so a later shared [member gravity] write keeps range-written slots. Non-finite values are rejected.

method.name: all_bullets_set_homing_smoothing
method.description: Sets the homing turn agility for each bullet in the range. Setting any per-bullet value enables per-bullet mode, after which the shared [member homing_smoothing] is ignored. Useful for mixed volleys with fast and drifting homers.

method.name: all_bullets_set_movement_pattern_from_curve
method.description:
Sets a [Curve2D] drawn movement pattern to all bullets in the specified range. The bullets will follow the shape of the curve as they move.
If [code]face_movement_direction[/code] is set to true, the bullets will also rotate to face the direction they are moving along the curve.
If [code]repeat_pattern[/code] is set to true, once a bullet reaches the end of the curve pattern it will start again from the beginning, creating a loop. If false, once a bullet reaches the end of the curve pattern it will stop following it and continue moving in a straight line based on its current direction and speed.

method.name: all_bullets_set_movement_pattern_from_path
method.description:
Sets a [Path2D] drawn movement pattern to all bullets in the specified range. The bullets will follow the shape of the path as they move.
If [code]face_movement_direction[/code] is set to true, the bullets will also rotate to face the direction they are moving along the path.
If [code]repeat_pattern[/code] is set to true, once a bullet reaches the end of the path pattern it will start again from the beginning, creating a loop. If false, once a bullet reaches the end of the path pattern it will stop following it and continue moving in a straight line based on its current direction and speed.

method.name: all_bullets_set_orbiting_center
method.description: Re-pins the locked ring center for each locked bullet in the range without unlocking. Unlocked or disabled bullets warn and are skipped.

method.name: all_bullets_set_orbiting_direction
method.description: Sets the orbiting direction for all bullets in the range. Passing OrbitRandom re-rolls OrbitLeft or OrbitRight per bullet (never DontMove).

method.name: all_bullets_set_orbiting_follow_deadzone
method.description: Sets the follow deadzone in pixels for all bullets in the range. Only meaningful with FollowDeadzone mode; non-finite or negative values are rejected.

method.name: all_bullets_set_orbiting_follow_mode
method.description: Sets how the locked ring follows a moving target for all bullets in the range: FollowTarget tracks 1:1, FollowDeadzone pins the center inside the deadzone, Anchored freezes the ring where it locked.

method.name: all_bullets_set_orbiting_lock_policy
method.description: Sets what drops the orbit lock for all bullets in the range: RelockAlways re-acquires on every retarget, StayLocked never unlocks on retarget/empty, RelockOnTargetChange unlocks only when the front target changes identity.

method.name: all_bullets_set_orbiting_radius
method.description: Sets the orbiting radius for all bullets in the range.

method.name: all_bullets_set_orbiting_rigid_follow
method.description: Sets rigid follow for all bullets in the range. When on, locked bullets translate 1:1 with the target while circling, exactly like DontMove escorts. When off, locked bullets chase the ring clamped to speed times delta and trail behind fast targets.

method.name: all_bullets_set_orbiting_texture_rotation
method.description: Sets the orbiting texture rotation for all bullets in the range.

method.name: all_bullets_set_rotation_data
method.description: Fans one rotation triple over a range (null and non-finite values rejected). Mirrors [method all_bullets_set_speed_data].

method.name: all_bullets_set_speed_data
method.description: Sets the same speed data to all bullets in the specified range. Speed data is a [BulletSpeedData2D] resource that can contain multiple properties used to control different aspects of the bullet's speed behavior, such as initial speed, acceleration, deceleration, max speed, etc...

method.name: all_bullets_set_texture_rotation_degrees
method.description: Sets the same texture rotation in degrees to all bullets in the specified range.

method.name: all_bullets_set_texture_rotation_radians
method.description: Sets the same texture rotation in radians to all bullets in the specified range.

method.name: all_bullets_set_texture_rotation_towards_node2d
method.description: Sets the texture rotation of all bullets in the specified range towards a target [Node2D]. The rotation will be set so that the bullet's texture faces towards the target node.

method.name: all_bullets_set_texture_rotation_towards_position
method.description: Sets the texture rotation of all bullets in the specified range towards a target global position. The rotation will be set so that the bullet's texture faces towards the target position.

method.name: all_bullets_set_trail_enabled
method.description: Toggles one trail layer over a bullet range. Hidden bullets show no trail; re-enabling resumes it on the next tick.

method.name: all_bullets_set_transforms
method.description:
Sets the same transform to all bullets in the specified range. A transform is a [Transform2D] that contains the bullet's position, rotation and scale. If you want to set them separately, use [method all_bullets_set_direction], [method all_bullets_set_texture_rotation_degrees], [method all_bullets_set_texture_rotation_radians] or [method all_bullets_set_speed_data].
If [code]set_direction_based_on_transform[/code] is set to true, the direction of the bullets will be set based on the rotation of the provided transform. If false, the transform's rotation will be ignored and only its position and scale will be applied to the bullets, keeping their original direction. The direction gets normalized automatically.

method.name: all_bullets_set_velocity
method.description: Sets the exact velocity of all bullets in the range (wind, knockback, slow fields). Decomposes into direction and speed so the integrator keeps producing it. Non-finite input is rejected.

method.name: all_bullets_set_wobble_data
method.description: Seeds wobble live over a range (null clears each slot back to the shared fallback). Per-bullet wins over shared.

method.name: attach_time_based_function
method.description: Runs [param callable] after [param time] seconds of volley time (paused with the factory), repeating every [param time] seconds when [param repeat] is on (a repeating timer never fires more than once per tick, even after a hitch). [param execute_only_if_volley_is_active] (default [code]true[/code]): the timer runs only while the volley is active. While the volley is parked it holds its remaining time and resumes on the wake, so a one-shot is never lost. With [code]false[/code] it keeps running and firing while the volley is parked, so it can wake the volley itself. Timers are released when the volley returns to the pool. Attaching and detaching apply immediately, even from inside a timer callback. At most 64 timers per volley.

method.name: bullet_check_has_homing_targets
method.description:
Returns true if the specified bullet has any homing targets in its per-bullet deque.
If you want to check if the shared deque has any targets, use [method shared_homing_deque_check_has_homing_targets] instead.

method.name: bullet_clear_homing_targets
method.description:
Clears all homing targets from the specified bullet's per-bullet deque. Resets individual path; shared unaffected.
If you want to clear all bullet targets for a shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_clear_homing_targets] instead.

method.name: bullet_disable_attachment
method.description: Disables the attachment of a specific bullet by calling its virtual function [method BulletAttachment2D.on_bullet_disable].

method.name: bullet_disable_orbiting
method.description: Disables orbiting for the specified bullet.

method.name: bullet_enable_attachment
method.description: Enables the attachment of a specific bullet, if it has one.

method.name: bullet_enable_orbiting
method.description:
Enables orbiting for the specified bullet with the given parameters. Invalid direction or texture rotation values are rejected with an error and orbiting stays disabled. Enabling on a disabled bullet is rejected: wake it with [method enable_bullet] first, then push targets and enable orbiting. DontMove as direction means escort: the bullet holds a fixed slot on the ring and follows the target without circling. Tangential texture rotations (FaceOrbitingDirection, FaceOppositeOrbitingDirection) have no effect for escorts since there is no direction of travel. The follow mode controls how the locked ring tracks a moving target (FollowTarget, FollowDeadzone with a pixel deadzone, or Anchored), the lock policy controls what drops the lock (RelockAlways, StayLocked, or RelockOnTargetChange), and rigid follow controls whether circling bullets translate 1:1 with the target like escorts (on) or chase the ring and trail behind fast targets (off).
Note that orbiting relies on having a homing target to orbit around. Push targets only onto enabled bullets for the same reason; the spawner retarget pass skips disabled slots automatically.
Example: [code]bullets.bullet_enable_orbiting(0, 90.0, 2); bullets.bullet_homing_push_back_global_position_target(0, boss.global_position)[/code], then read [method debug_get_orbiting_info].

method.name: bullet_free_attachment
method.description:
Frees the attachment of a specific bullet: the slot is cleared at once, the node is hidden and queue_free()d (deleted at the end of the frame), so this is safe to call from the attachment's own callbacks. Use this if you want to permanently remove an attachment from a bullet and free its resources, instead of just disabling it with [method bullet_disable_attachment].
Warning: Once you free an attachment, you can't reuse it anymore.

method.name: bullet_get_attachment
method.description: Gets the attachment of a specific bullet. Returns a [BulletAttachment2D], which can be null if the bullet doesn't have an attachment.

method.name: bullet_get_bounce_count
method.description: How many times the specified bullet has bounced in its current life. Invalid indexes read 0. Cleared on disable and on every pool reuse.

method.name: bullet_get_current_homing_target
method.description:
Returns the current (front) homing target for the specified bullet's per-bullet deque as Variant (Node2D or Vector2; nullptr if invalid/empty).
If you want to get the current target from the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_get_current_homing_target] instead.

method.name: bullet_get_curves_data
method.description: Gets the curves data of a specific bullet. Returns a [BulletCurvesData2D], or null (with an error, since reading an empty slot is usually a mistake) when the bullet has no individual curves data: check [member shared_bullet_curves_data] for the shared one. Curves data is a [BulletCurvesData2D] resource that can contain multiple curves used to control different aspects of the bullet's behavior over time, such as movement speed, rotation speed, direction adjustment, etc... Note: If you want to set or get the curves data of multiple bullets at once, use [method all_bullets_set_curves_data] or [method all_bullets_get_curves_data].

method.name: bullet_get_custom_data
method.description: Gets the per-bullet custom data of a specific bullet, null when none is set. Strictly separate from [member shared_bullets_custom_data] - read that member for the shared value.

method.name: bullet_get_fall_speed
method.description: Integrated fall speed magnitude for the specified bullet. 0 when gravity never integrated there.

method.name: bullet_get_gravity
method.description: Per-bullet gravity acceleration vector for the specified bullet. Invalid indexes read (0, 0).

method.name: bullet_get_homing_smoothing
method.description: Returns the effective homing turn agility for the specified bullet: its per-bullet value when per-bullet mode is active, otherwise the shared [member homing_smoothing].

method.name: bullet_get_orbiting_angle
method.description: Returns the locked ring angle in radians for the specified bullet (the slot it holds on the ring).

method.name: bullet_get_orbiting_center
method.description: Returns the current ring center for the specified bullet: the locked center when locked, otherwise the live front-target position.

method.name: bullet_get_orbiting_direction
method.description: Returns the orbiting direction for the specified bullet.

method.name: bullet_get_orbiting_follow_deadzone
method.description: Returns the follow deadzone in pixels for the specified bullet.

method.name: bullet_get_orbiting_follow_mode
method.description: Returns how the locked ring follows a moving target for the specified bullet.

method.name: bullet_get_orbiting_lock_policy
method.description: Returns what drops the orbit lock for the specified bullet.

method.name: bullet_get_orbiting_radius
method.description: Returns the orbiting radius for the specified bullet.

method.name: bullet_get_orbiting_rigid_follow
method.description: Returns whether the specified bullet uses rigid follow (locked bullets translate 1:1 with the target while circling).

method.name: bullet_get_orbiting_texture_rotation
method.description: Returns the orbiting texture rotation for the specified bullet.

method.name: bullet_get_rotation_speed
method.description: Effective per-bullet rotation speed (seeded value, live-updated by the tick). 0 when inactive or out of range.

method.name: bullet_get_wobble_amplitude
method.description: Effective wobble amplitude of one bullet (seeded amplitude, 0 when inactive).

method.name: bullet_get_wobble_data
method.description: Per-bullet wobble resource of one bullet (null when the slot runs on the shared fallback or is inactive).

method.name: bullet_get_wobble_face_movement_direction
method.description: Whether the bullet's wobble visual follows the steered heading (seeded face flag, false when inactive).

method.name: bullet_get_wobble_face_rotation_speed
method.description: Slew limit of the bullet's wobble texture follow in rad/s (seeded value, 0 when inactive).

method.name: bullet_homing_check_current_target_type
method.description:
Returns the type of the current (front) homing target for the specified bullet's per-bullet deque (NotHoming if empty).
If you want to check the type of the current target from the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_check_current_target_type] instead.

method.name: bullet_homing_check_targets_amount
method.description:
Returns the number of homing targets in the specified bullet's per-bullet deque.
If you want to check the number of targets in the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_check_homing_targets_amount] instead.

method.name: bullet_homing_pop_back_target
method.description:
Pops and returns the back homing target from the specified bullet's per-bullet deque (Variant: Node2D or Vector2; nullptr if invalid/empty).
If you want to pop the back target from the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_pop_back_target] instead.

method.name: bullet_homing_pop_front_target
method.description:
Pops and returns the front (current) homing target from the specified bullet's per-bullet deque (Variant: Node2D or Vector2; nullptr if invalid/empty).
If you want to pop the front target from the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_pop_front_target] instead.

method.name: bullet_homing_push_back_global_position_target
method.description:
Pushes a global position target to the back of the specified bullet's per-bullet deque. Returns true on success (bullet enabled/valid index). Per-bullet deque wins over the shared deque per bullet; a drained per-bullet deque falls back to shared. Example: [code]bullets.bullet_homing_push_back_global_position_target(0, boss.global_position)[/code].
If you want to push back a target to the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_push_back_global_position_target] instead.

method.name: bullet_homing_push_back_homing_target
method.description: Pushes a Node2D or Vector2 target to the back of the specified bullet's per-bullet deque. Returns false with an error on invalid index or target type, pushing nothing.

method.name: bullet_homing_push_back_mouse_position_target
method.description:
Pushes the current mouse global position to the back of the specified bullet's per-bullet deque. Returns true on success; caches for perf.
If you want to push back a mouse position target to the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_push_back_mouse_position_target] instead.

method.name: bullet_homing_push_back_node2d_target
method.description:
Pushes a Node2D target to the back of the specified bullet's per-bullet deque. Returns true on success (bullet enabled/valid index/target).
If you want to push back a target to the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_push_back_node2d_target] instead.

method.name: bullet_homing_push_front_global_position_target
method.description:
Pushes a global position target to the front of the specified bullet's per-bullet deque. Returns true on success (bullet enabled/valid index).
If you want to push front a target to the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_push_front_global_position_target] instead.

method.name: bullet_homing_push_front_homing_target
method.description: Pushes a Node2D or Vector2 target to the front of the specified bullet's per-bullet deque. Returns false with an error on invalid index or target type, pushing nothing.

method.name: bullet_homing_push_front_mouse_position_target
method.description:
Pushes the current mouse global position to the front of the specified bullet's per-bullet deque. Returns true on success.
If you want to push front a mouse position target to the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_push_front_mouse_position_target] instead.

method.name: bullet_homing_push_front_node2d_target
method.description:
Pushes a Node2D target to the front of the specified bullet's per-bullet deque. Returns true on success (bullet enabled/valid index/target).
If you want to push front a target to the shared deque, use [method shared_homing_deque_push_front_node2d_target] instead.

method.name: bullet_is_orbiting_enabled
method.description: Whether orbiting is currently enabled for the specified bullet.

method.name: bullet_is_orbiting_locked
method.description: Returns whether the specified bullet is currently locked onto its orbit ring (as opposed to merely enabled but still flying to the ring).

method.name: bullet_replace_homing_targets_with_new_target
method.description: Replaces the specified bullet's per-bullet homing queue with a single new target (Node2D or Vector2) while preserving the orbit lock under StayLocked and RelockOnTargetChange (same front target keeps angle and center). Returns true when replaced; false when the slot is disabled or the target is invalid (nothing changed).

method.name: bullet_reset_graze
method.description: Clears bullet [param bullet_index]'s graze state in every zone: it may graze every ring again and an open visit ends silently. [method bullet_reset_state] does this too.

method.name: bullet_reset_state
method.description: Clears one bullet's runtime ledgers without touching its flight: hit count, bounce ledger, homing queue, orbiting (turned off), fall speed, wobble phase and movement-pattern progress. Use it to wake a frozen bullet fresh, or call [method disable_bullet] with [code]reset_state[/code].

method.name: bullet_set_attachment
method.description: Spawns an attachment to a specific bullet. An attachment is a [BulletAttachment2D] that can contain a [Node2D] with particles, lights, etc... that will be attached to the bullet and follow it around. Pooling is keyed by the scene itself, so every loader of the same scene shares one pool bucket.

method.name: bullet_set_attachment_to_null
method.description:
Removes the attachment of a specific bullet by setting it to null. Returns the removed [BulletAttachment2D] attachment, which can be useful if you want to reuse it as it is not freed, just detached from the bullet.
A cool trick you can do is, when a bullet collides or you want to disable it manually (with [method disable_bullet]) but keep its attachment active for a bit longer (for example, to let some particles or lights finish their effect), you can call this function to detach the attachment from the bullet and keep it on the scene.
Warning: You have to take care of the returned attachment yourself.

method.name: bullet_set_curves_data
method.description:
Sets the curves data of a specific bullet. Curves data is a [BulletCurvesData2D] resource that can contain multiple curves used to control different aspects of the bullet's behavior over time, such as movement speed, rotation speed, direction adjustment, etc... Pass null to clear back to the shared fallback (see [method clear_per_bullet_curves_data]). Example: [code]bullets.bullet_set_curves_data(0, my_curves); print(bullets.debug_get_curves_info(0)["speed_src"])[/code] prints "per".
Note: If you want to set or get the curves data of multiple bullets at once, use [method all_bullets_set_curves_data] or [method all_bullets_get_curves_data].

method.name: bullet_set_custom_data
method.description: Sets the custom data of a specific bullet. Pass null to clear it (reads as null afterwards, never as the shared value).

method.name: bullet_set_gravity
method.description: Sets the gravity acceleration for one bullet and restarts its fall speed (new regime). The write claims presence like a seeded entry (even a deliberate zero), so a later shared [member gravity] write cannot silently undo it. Non-finite values are rejected. Example: [code]bullets.bullet_set_gravity(0, Vector2(0, 400)); print(bullets.debug_get_gravity_info(0)["vector"])[/code].

method.name: bullet_set_homing_smoothing
method.description: Sets the homing turn agility for the specified bullet. Enables per-bullet mode for the whole volley (see [method all_bullets_set_homing_smoothing]). Non-finite or negative values are rejected.

method.name: bullet_set_orbiting_center
method.description: Re-pins the locked ring center for the specified bullet without unlocking. Rejected when orbiting is disabled or the bullet never locked.

method.name: bullet_set_orbiting_direction
method.description: Sets the orbiting direction for the specified bullet. Invalid values are rejected with an error and the direction stays unchanged. Passing OrbitRandom rolls OrbitLeft or OrbitRight (never DontMove).

method.name: bullet_set_orbiting_follow_deadzone
method.description: Sets the follow deadzone in pixels for the specified bullet. Only meaningful with FollowDeadzone mode; non-finite or negative values are rejected.

method.name: bullet_set_orbiting_follow_mode
method.description: Sets how the locked ring follows a moving target for the specified bullet: FollowTarget tracks 1:1, FollowDeadzone pins the center inside the deadzone, Anchored freezes the ring where it locked.

method.name: bullet_set_orbiting_lock_policy
method.description: Sets what drops the orbit lock for the specified bullet: RelockAlways re-acquires on every retarget, StayLocked never unlocks on retarget/empty, RelockOnTargetChange unlocks only when the front target changes identity.

method.name: bullet_set_orbiting_radius
method.description: Sets the orbiting radius for the specified bullet. Writing the current value keeps the lock; a changed value re-locks.

method.name: bullet_set_orbiting_rigid_follow
method.description: Sets rigid follow for the specified bullet without dropping the lock. When on, locked bullets translate 1:1 with the target while circling, exactly like DontMove escorts. When off, locked bullets chase the ring clamped to speed times delta and trail behind fast targets.

method.name: bullet_set_orbiting_texture_rotation
method.description: Sets the orbiting texture rotation for the specified bullet. Invalid values are rejected with an error and the rotation stays unchanged.

method.name: bullet_set_trail_enabled
method.description: Toggles one trail layer for one bullet. Takes effect immediately (no tick wait).

method.name: bullet_set_velocity
method.description: Sets the exact velocity of the specified bullet (wind, knockback, split inheritance). See [method all_bullets_set_velocity] for details.

method.name: bullet_set_wobble_data
method.description: Seeds wobble live for one bullet (null clears it back to the shared fallback, or inactive when unset). Invalid data errors and clears to the fallback. Example: [code]bullets.bullet_set_wobble_data(1, my_wobble); print(bullets.debug_get_wobble_info(1)["active"])[/code].

method.name: clear_all_bullets
method.description: Clears every live bullet through [method clear_bullet] (On Clear effects fire; mass clears recycle the oldest effect slots so hundreds of bullets never spawn hundreds of live effects). Returns how many bullets were cleared. Allowed inside collision and lifetime handlers.

method.name: clear_bullet
method.description: Manual clear with visuals: disables the bullet and fires On Clear effect layers at its death pose. Already-dead or invalid slots return false and stay silent (no double fire). Collision kills fire On Destroy and timeouts fire On Lifetime Over through their own paths, never On Clear.

method.name: clear_bullet_rotation_data
method.description: Turns rotation off for the whole volley (same as seeding an empty array). Re-seed with spawn/enable or [method set_bullet_rotation_data] to spin again.

method.name: clear_per_bullet_curves_data
method.description: Clears one bullet's per-bullet curves back to the shared fallback (or no curves when unset). Same as [method bullet_set_curves_data] with null, kept for symmetry with [method clear_per_bullet_homing_smoothing].

method.name: clear_per_bullet_homing_smoothing
method.description: Clears per-bullet smoothing mode: the shared [member homing_smoothing] drives every bullet again. No-op when per-bullet mode was never enabled.

method.name: debug_dedup_find_collision
method.description: Brute-force key-collision search over probe_count deterministic distinct pairs. Returns collided and probes. Test-only: pins the 64-bit dedup key against birthday collisions.

method.name: debug_dedup_mark
method.description: Marks one (bullet, target) pair as queued in the live dedup table. Test-only: call on an idle volley with no overlaps in flight.

method.name: debug_dedup_probe
method.description: Whether one (bullet, target) pair is already queued in the live dedup table. Test-only: call on an idle volley with no overlaps in flight.

method.name: debug_dedup_reset
method.description: Clears the live dedup table (same clear the drain runs, including the cold-table shrink). Test-only: call on an idle volley with no overlaps in flight.

method.name: debug_dedup_stats
method.description: Dedup table introspection: used pairs, slot capacity, and the collision_dedup_by_object mode.

method.name: debug_get_attachment_info
method.description: Attachment slot introspection: has_attachment, pooling_id, owner_match. owner_match verifies the attachment's owner ids point back at this volley + index (stale ownership after reuse fails here). No range variant exists; loop bullet indices instead.

method.name: debug_get_bounce_info
method.description: Bounce introspection for one bullet: counts, config echo (mask, strength, mode, max), whether bouncing is armed, pending smooth-visual state and cooldown. Never mutates. Out-of-range indexes report valid = false.

method.name: debug_get_bullet_info
method.description: Full per-bullet steering snapshot: {index, valid, active, direction, velocity, speed, gravity, fall_speed, wobble_active, wobble_amplitude, has_homing_targets, homing_targets_amount, homing_smoothing, orbiting_enabled, orbiting_locked, pattern, shared_pattern_active, rotation_speed}. Never mutates; invalid index returns valid=false with zeroed fields.

method.name: debug_get_clocks
method.description: Debug/test helper: a read-only snapshot of every clock the volley advances (curve clock, lifetime, homing interval, sprite animation, fade, custom timers, bounce cooldowns).

method.name: debug_get_curves_info
method.description: Per-channel curves winner for one bullet: {valid, x_src, y_src, rot_src, speed_src, gravity_src, has_per_bullet_resource, has_shared_fallback}, where each *_src is "per", "shared" or "none". Example: with shared x + per-bullet y, x_src is "shared" and y_src is "per". Never mutates; invalid index returns valid=false.

method.name: debug_get_effect_layers_info
method.description: Baked trail-layer state: data layer count, and per bake the layer index, frame/shard counts, applied z_index/z_as_relative/modulate/visibility_layer/light_mask, visible shards, tracked bullets, and live trail rows (bullet, shard, tint).

method.name: debug_get_gravity_info
method.description: Gravity introspection: vector, fall_speed, window_active, curve_scale. Never mutates.

method.name: debug_get_graze_info
method.description: Graze introspection: armed, zone_slots, state_bytes, active_this_tick (some zone had a live target), pending_events (queued for the next dispatch), dispatched_events, bullet_radius (added when a zone counts bullet size), generation.

method.name: debug_get_life_state
method.description: Debug/test helper: [code]"active"[/code], [code]"parked"[/code] or [code]"pooled"[/code].

method.name: debug_get_orbiting_info
method.description: Orbiting introspection for one bullet: {valid, enabled, locked, center, angle, radius, direction, texture_rotation, follow_mode, deadzone, lock_policy, rigid_follow, deque_src}, where deque_src is "locked" once the ring locks, else "per" when the bullet has its own deque, "shared" when it falls back to the shared deque, or "none". Per-bullet deque wins over shared, same as the steering tick. Example: [code]var info = bullets.debug_get_orbiting_info(0); print(info["deque_src"])[/code]. Never mutates; invalid index returns valid=false.

method.name: debug_get_pattern_info
method.description: Movement-pattern state for one bullet: {valid, src, face, repeat, distance, length, finished, has_shared_fallback}, where src is "per", "shared" or "none". Finished shared parks at length; finished per-bullet clears back to src "none". Never mutates; invalid index returns valid=false.

method.name: debug_get_previous_origin
method.description: Previous-tick origin used by physics interpolation. Lets tests prove the render path stays continuous across teleports and bounces (rotation may snap while position keeps lerping).

method.name: debug_get_shape_state
method.description: Collision shape state: valid, type, circle_radius, rect_size, capsule_radius, capsule_height, rid_count. Asserts set_collision_shape_runtime same-type vs type-change paths.

method.name: debug_get_timer_count
method.description: Attached timer count (0 = no per-tick timer cost). Asserts the 64-timer cap and detach-during-fire behavior.

method.name: debug_get_trail_transform
method.description: Last written local trail instance transform for one bullet (zero Transform2D when it has no visible trail instance on that layer).

method.name: debug_get_volley_info
method.description: Stability introspection: amount_bullets, active_bullets, generation, owner_spawner_id, is_active, is_pooled, pool_amount, pool_shape, auto_pool_volley, auto_pool_attachments.

method.name: debug_get_wobble_info
method.description: Wobble introspection for tests/support: {active, amplitude, frequency_hz, mode, waveform, phase, damping_per_sec, delay_sec, duration_sec, face_movement_direction, face_rotation_speed, has_per_bullet_resource, has_shared_fallback}. Example: [code]var w = bullets.debug_get_wobble_info(0); print(w["amplitude"])[/code]. Never mutates.

method.name: debug_run_interpolation_pass
method.description: Runs the render interpolation pass on demand (same code the factory _process drives): lets tests prove trail shards follow the lerped bullet pose with zero physics ticks in between. No-op unless the factory has use_physics_interpolation on.

method.name: detach_all_time_based_functions
method.description: Detaches all time based functions that were previously attached.

method.name: detach_time_based_function
method.description: Detaches a specific time based callable. This will work as long as the callable you are trying to detach was previously saved in a variable or defined as a normal Godot function.

method.name: disable_bullet
method.description: Disables (freezes) one bullet: it stops moving, colliding and drawing, but keeps its state (ballistics, hit count, bounce ledger, homing queue, orbit, wobble phase, fall speed, custom data), so [method enable_bullet] resumes it exactly. Silent: no effect layer fires (use [method clear_bullet] for a visible removal). [param release_attachment]: [code]true[/code] (default) releases the attachment to the pool; [code]false[/code] suspends it in its slot (on_bullet_disable) and the wake resumes it. [param reset_state]: [code]true[/code] also clears the ledgers ([method bullet_reset_state]). When the last bullet goes, the volley returns to the pool if [member is_auto_pooling_enabled] is on, otherwise it parks (frozen and still yours).

method.name: enable_bullet
method.description: Wakes a disabled (frozen) bullet: it resumes exactly where it stopped, with its ballistics, homing, orbit, custom data and suspended attachment. [param collision_amount]: -1 (default) keeps the bullet's hit count, any other value sets it. Waking a parked volley resumes the whole volley (owner and volley features included); a volley that expired gets a fresh lifetime and curve clock. A volley that already went back to the pool (its last bullet died with [member is_auto_pooling_enabled] on) cannot be woken: the call is refused with an error, because the handle is stale. Spawn a new volley instead, or turn auto pooling off before the last bullet dies to keep the volley parked.

method.name: enable_volley
method.description: Manual-pooling reseed: reactivates a fully-disabled volley with fresh data (same amount_bullets required; a different collision shape type is refused inside the physics step: spawn through [BulletFactory2D] instead, which pops a matching pool bucket, or call it from an idle frame). Refuses on active/queued/wrong-type/null/NaN-offset input without touching state. This is the cross-owner reuse path for manual poolers; same-owner revive uses enable_bullet/wake_bullet.

method.name: get_all_bullets_status
method.description: Get the status of all bullets inside the volley - whether they are enabled (active and visible on screen) or disabled (inactive and invisible)

method.name: get_amount_active_attachments
method.description: Returns how many bullets of this multimesh currently have an attachment assigned. Useful for debugging attachment pooling on a [BulletFactory2D] controllable handle.

method.name: get_amount_bullets
method.description: Get the amount of bullets inside the volley

method.name: get_bullet_collision_count
method.description: Get how many times a specific bullet has collided so far. See [method set_bullet_collision_count] for writing it.

method.name: get_bullet_direction
method.description: Get the direction of a specific bullet. Returns a [Vector2] direction.

method.name: get_bullet_global_transform
method.description: Get a specific bullet's transform in global space (the caches already hold global-space transforms). Use this when you need world coordinates, for example to spawn child bullets exactly where a bullet died. [method get_bullet_transform] returns the same transform instead.

method.name: get_bullet_grazed_rings
method.description: Bitmask of the rings of zone [param zone_index] that bullet [param bullet_index] already grazed (bit k = ring k). With [constant BulletGrazeZone2D.REGRAZE_ONCE] the bits stay for the bullet's life.

method.name: get_bullet_movement_pattern_curve
method.description: Get the movement pattern curve of a specific bullet.

method.name: get_bullet_rotation_data
method.description: Live rotation triple of a specific bullet (rotation/max/accel). Read, tweak, and write back with [method set_bullet_rotation_data]. Out-of-range reads return a zeroed resource.

method.name: get_bullet_speed_data
method.description: Get the speed data of a specific bullet. Returns a [BulletSpeedData2D] resource.

method.name: get_bullet_texture_rotation_degrees
method.description: Get the texture rotation in degrees of a specific bullet. Returns a float representing the rotation in degrees.

method.name: get_bullet_texture_rotation_radians
method.description: Get the texture rotation in radians of a specific bullet, in the same space [method set_bullet_texture_rotation_radians] writes: the volley-wide spawn-data [code]texture_rotation_radians[/code] offset is excluded, so [code]set(get())[/code] is a no-op. Wrapped to [-PI, PI] when an offset is set.

method.name: get_bullet_transform
method.description: Get the transform of a specific bullet in global space (the same space as [method set_bullet_transform] and [method get_bullet_global_transform]). Returns a [Transform2D] containing the bullet's position, rotation and scale.

method.name: get_bullet_velocity
method.description: Logical velocity of a specific bullet (direction x speed + inherited offset + integrated gravity fall speed when gravity is active). Excludes per-tick pattern/orbit displacement, which steers the movement delta after this value is computed. Use this for gameplay logic such as splitting bullets or speed checks.

method.name: get_collision_layer
method.description: Get the collision layer of the multimesh.

method.name: get_collision_mask
method.description: Get the collision mask of the multimesh.

method.name: get_collision_shape
method.description: The collision shape currently cached for this multimesh.

method.name: get_fade_base_modulate
method.description: Base tint the fade tick multiplies. Snapshotted from spawn data on every spawn/enable; change it here at runtime (not through the CanvasItem setter, which the next fade tick would overwrite while any fade is configured).

method.name: get_graze_zones
method.description: The zones armed on this volley, with null in empty slots (the index is the zone index used by the readouts).

method.name: get_is_wobble_enabled
method.description: Whether any wobble entry is currently enabled on this volley (shared or per-bullet). Set wobble data through [member BulletVolleyData2D.shared_bullet_wobble_data] or [member BulletVolleyData2D.all_bullet_wobble_data] before spawning, or live via [method bullet_set_wobble_data] / [method set_shared_bullet_wobble_data].

method.name: get_life_id
method.description: The id of the volley's current life: it changes every time the volley is spawned or reused from the pool. Store it with a handle and compare later to know whether the volley still belongs to the same spawn.

method.name: get_life_time_left
method.description: Seconds left until the volley's bullets expire (0 once expired, and always 0 for an infinite lifetime).

method.name: get_monitorable
method.description: Check if the multimesh is monitorable.

method.name: get_sprite_animation
method.description: Currently playing SpriteFrames animation (one per multimesh batch).

method.name: get_sprite_frame
method.description: Current frame index within the playing animation.

method.name: get_sprite_frame_count
method.description: Amount of baked frames in the playing animation.

method.name: get_sprite_frames
method.description: Cached SpriteFrames source of the playing animation. The bake is a snapshot: later edits to the resource need a replay via [method play_sprite_animation] or [method play_sprite_animation_name]. Playing on a pooled (inactive) instance applies immediately but is discarded by the next pool-reuse bake.

method.name: graze_clear
method.description: Disarms graze on this volley: zones released, per-bullet state and queued events dropped. Refused on a pooled handle.

method.name: graze_set_zones
method.description: Arms this volley with up to [constant MAX_GRAZE_ZONES] [BulletGrazeZone2D] zones (null entries are skipped but keep their index) and resets every bullet's graze state. Use it for volleys spawned straight from [BulletFactory2D]; spawner volleys are armed by [member BulletSpawner2D.graze_zones]. Returns false and changes nothing for more than 4 entries or a non-zone entry; refused on a pooled handle.

method.name: has_bullet_movement_pattern
method.description: Check if a specific bullet has a movement pattern assigned to it, either from a [Path2D] or a [Curve2D]. Returns true if the bullet has a movement pattern, false if it doesn't. Note: A bullet can have its movement pattern removed by using [method remove_bullet_movement_pattern] or [method all_bullets_remove_movement_pattern].

method.name: has_shared_bullet_curves_data
method.description: Whether shared bullet curves are currently set.

method.name: has_shared_bullet_rotation_data
method.description: Whether a shared rotation is currently set.

method.name: has_shared_bullet_speed_data
method.description: Whether a shared speed is currently set.

method.name: has_shared_bullet_wobble_data
method.description: Whether a shared wobble fallback is currently set.

method.name: has_shared_movement_pattern
method.description: Whether a shared movement pattern curve is currently set.

method.name: has_trail_effects
method.description: Whether any trail layer is currently baked on this volley.

method.name: is_bullet_inside_graze
method.description: Whether bullet [param bullet_index] was inside zone [param zone_index]'s outermost ring at the end of its last evaluated tick.

method.name: is_bullet_status_enabled
method.description: Check the status of a specific bullet - whether it is enabled (active and visible on screen) or disabled (inactive and invisible)

method.name: is_graze_armed
method.description: Whether at least one graze zone is armed on this volley.

method.name: is_parked
method.description: Whether every bullet is disabled but the volley was kept (auto pooling off): frozen and still yours, wake it with [method enable_bullet].

method.name: is_pooled
method.description: Whether the volley is back in the factory's pool (its last bullet died with auto pooling on). A pooled handle is stale: it cannot be woken, and the next spawn may reuse it for anyone.

method.name: is_rotation_data_active
method.description: Whether rotation data is currently driving the volley (any seeded rotation array, shared or per-bullet).

method.name: is_sprite_animation_finished
method.description: True after a non-looping animation reached its last frame (emits sprite_animation_finished once, deferred).

method.name: is_sprite_animation_playing
method.description: True when active, unpaused, unfinished, with more than one baked frame.

method.name: play_effect_animation
method.description: Switches one trail layer to another baked animation (shard nodes rebuild; per-bullet phase and toggles survive). One-shot layers switch through their layer resource plus [method set_effect_layers]. Returns false when the layer or animation is missing.

method.name: play_sprite_animation
method.description: Switches this multimesh to a SpriteFrames animation (bakes frames, per-frame seconds from fps-relative durations, loop flag; AtlasTexture frames supported). Empty or missing "default" auto-resolves silently to the first animation; explicit wrong names fall back with one error. Returns false on null/empty/missing with previous animation untouched. Note: pooled reuse re-bakes from spawn data and disconnects these handlers, so reconnect after reuse if needed.

method.name: play_sprite_animation_name
method.description: Switches animation reusing the cached SpriteFrames source. Same resolve rules (empty or missing "default" auto-resolves to the first animation). Errors only when no source cached yet.

method.name: remove_bullet_movement_pattern
method.description: Removes the movement pattern from a specific bullet, making it lose any [Path2D] or [Curve2D] drawn pattern it had and move solely based on its direction and speed data. Note: If you want to remove the movement pattern from multiple bullets at once, use [method all_bullets_remove_movement_pattern]. Note: A bullet can have a movement pattern assigned by using [method set_bullet_movement_pattern_from_curve] or [method set_bullet_movement_pattern_from_path].

method.name: remove_shared_bullet_curves_data
method.description: Removes the shared bullet curves (same as setting null). Per-bullet curves, if any, take over.

method.name: remove_shared_bullet_rotation_data
method.description: Removes the shared rotation (same as setting null). Per-bullet rotation data, if any, takes over.

method.name: remove_shared_bullet_speed_data
method.description: Removes the shared speed (same as setting null). Per-bullet speed data, if any, takes over.

method.name: remove_shared_bullet_wobble_data
method.description: Clears the shared wobble fallback; slots without a live per-bullet resource go inactive.

method.name: remove_shared_movement_pattern
method.description: Removes the shared movement pattern (same as setting a null curve). Per-bullet patterns, if any, take over.

method.name: reset_pooling_flags_to_default
method.description: Resets both pooling flags ([member is_auto_pooling_enabled] and [member is_attachments_auto_pooling_enabled]) to true. Use after taking over a pooled instance whose previous owner customized them.

method.name: restart_sprite_animation
method.description: Restarts the baked animation at frame 0 (unpauses, clears finished). Errors when nothing baked.

method.name: resume_sprite_animation
method.description: Unfreezes frame advancement.

method.name: set_bounce_mask_from_array
method.description: Rebuilds [member bounce_mask] live from layer numbers instead of raw bits, through the same path as [method set_bounce_mask] (ledger re-armed, or fully disarmed when the result is 0). Example: [code]set_bounce_mask_from_array([4])[/code] bounces off layer-4 targets.

method.name: set_bullet_collision_count
method.description: Set how many times a specific bullet has collided so far. Negative values become 0, values at or above [member bullet_max_collision_count] become max - 1 (exactly one hit remaining, when the max is above 0). Same clamp as [method enable_bullet]'s wake top-up. See [method get_bullet_collision_count] for reading it.

method.name: set_bullet_direction
method.description: Set the direction of a specific bullet to a new direction. The direction gets normalized automatically.

method.name: set_bullet_direction_towards_node2d
method.description: Set the direction of a specific bullet towards a target [Node2D]. The direction gets normalized automatically.

method.name: set_bullet_direction_towards_position
method.description: Set the direction of a specific bullet towards a target global position. The direction gets normalized automatically.

method.name: set_bullet_movement_pattern_from_curve
method.description:
Set a [Curve2D] drawn movement pattern to a specific bullet. The bullet will follow the shape of the curve as it moves. Per-bullet patterns always win over the shared fallback; null clears back to shared (or no pattern). Example: [code]bullets.set_bullet_movement_pattern_from_curve(0, my_curve, true); print(bullets.debug_get_pattern_info(0)["src"])[/code] prints "per".
If [code]face_movement_direction[/code] is set to true, the bullet will also rotate to face the direction it is moving along the curve.
If [code]repeat_pattern[/code] is set to true, once the bullet reaches the end of the curve pattern it will start again from the beginning, creating a loop. If false, once the bullet reaches the end of the curve pattern it will stop following it and continue moving in a straight line based on its current direction and speed. Note: If you want to set a movement pattern from a curve to multiple bullets at once, use [method all_bullets_set_movement_pattern_from_curve]. Note: A bullet can have its movement pattern removed by using [method remove_bullet_movement_pattern] or [method all_bullets_remove_movement_pattern]. Note: A bullet can only have one movement pattern at a time, so if you set a new movement pattern to a bullet that already has one, it will replace the previous one.

method.name: set_bullet_movement_pattern_from_path
method.description:
Set a [Path2D] drawn movement pattern to a specific bullet. The bullet will follow the shape of the path as it moves.
If [code]face_movement_direction[/code] is set to true, the bullet will also rotate to face the direction it is moving along the path.
If [code]repeat_pattern[/code] is set to true, once the bullet reaches the end of the path pattern it will start again from the beginning, creating a loop. If false, once the bullet reaches the end of the path pattern it will stop following it and continue moving in a straight line based on its current direction and speed. Note: If you want to set a movement pattern from a path to multiple bullets at once, use [method all_bullets_set_movement_pattern_from_path]. Note: A bullet can have its movement pattern removed by using [method remove_bullet_movement_pattern] or [method all_bullets_remove_movement_pattern]. Note: A bullet can only have one movement pattern at a time, so if you set a new movement pattern to a bullet that already has one, it will replace the previous one. Note: The [Path2D] used for setting a movement pattern doesn't need to be in the scene tree, since only its curve is used for the bullets movement. Warning: If you are using a [Path2D] that is in the scene tree and you modify its curve after setting it as a movement pattern for a bullet, it may cause unexpected behavior in the bullet's movement. This is because the bullet's movement pattern is based on the curve data of the [Path2D], and modifying it while it's being used can lead to inconsistencies. It's recommended to use a [Path2D] that is not in the scene tree or to avoid modifying its curve after assigning it as a movement pattern to bullets.

method.name: set_bullet_rotation_data
method.description: Live per-bullet rotation write (null and non-finite values rejected). Mirrors [method set_bullet_speed_data].

method.name: set_bullet_speed_data
method.description: Set the speed data of a specific bullet (null and non-finite values rejected; a winning movement-speed curve blocks the write until cleared). Example: [code]var s = BulletSpeedData2D.new(); s.speed = 200.0; bullets.set_bullet_speed_data(0, s)[/code].

method.name: set_bullet_texture_rotation_degrees
method.description: Set the texture rotation in degrees of a specific bullet.

method.name: set_bullet_texture_rotation_radians
method.description: Set the texture rotation in radians of a specific bullet. Composes with the volley-wide texture offset, so direction math that strips the offset stays exact. Stick-relative attachments follow immediately.

method.name: set_bullet_texture_rotation_towards_node2d
method.description: Set the texture rotation of a specific bullet towards a target [Node2D]. The rotation will be set so that the bullet's texture faces towards the target node. Composes with the volley-wide texture offset (physics shape stays logical). Stick-relative attachments follow immediately.

method.name: set_bullet_texture_rotation_towards_position
method.description: Set the texture rotation of a specific bullet towards a target global position. The rotation will be set so that the bullet's texture faces towards the target position. Composes with the volley-wide texture offset (physics shape stays logical). Stick-relative attachments follow immediately.

method.name: set_bullet_transform
method.description: Set the transform of a specific bullet, in global space (matching [method get_bullet_transform] and [method get_bullet_global_transform]). Zero-scale and non-finite transforms are rejected. With set_direction_based_on_transform, the logical direction is derived from the transform with the volley-wide texture offset stripped (same convention as the tick), unless a direction curve owns the direction.

method.name: set_collision_layer
method.description: Sets the collision layer of the multimesh.

method.name: set_collision_layer_from_array
method.description: Sets the collision layer of the multimesh by providing an array of integers, where each integer represents a layer to be added to the collision layer.

method.name: set_collision_mask
method.description: Sets the collision mask of the multimesh.

method.name: set_collision_mask_from_array
method.description: Sets the collision mask of the multimesh by providing an array of integers, where each integer represents a mask to be added to the collision mask.

method.name: set_collision_shape_runtime
method.description:
Swaps the collision shape live, on an active or pooled volley. Size-only changes apply to every bullet right away through the physics server. A different effective type additionally rebuilds the physics shapes and moves pooled instances into the matching pool bucket. The visual QuadMesh is texture-driven and stays untouched. The debugger picks up the new type and size on the next physics tick.
Note: cannot run while bullets are being processed or inside a physics frame (same contract as the factory structural methods): use [method set_collision_shape_runtime_deferred] from handlers.

method.name: set_collision_shape_runtime_deferred
method.description: Deferred twin of [method set_collision_shape_runtime]: queued on the factory's idle structural queue, so it is safe to call from collision and lifetime handlers (where a shape change is rejected).

method.name: set_fade_base_modulate
method.description: Retints the fade base at runtime and re-arms the fade tick so the next frame writes even when the value matches the stale snapshot.

method.name: set_life_time_left
method.description: Sets the seconds left until the volley's bullets expire, e.g. from a [signal BulletFactory2D.life_time_over] handler to give them more time (which vetoes that expiry). Must be finite and above 0; refused on an infinite-lifetime volley.

method.name: set_monitorable
method.description: Sets whether the multimesh is monitorable or not.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_check_current_target_type
method.description:
Returns the type of the current (front) homing target in the shared deque (NotHoming if empty).
If you want to check the type of the current target from a specific bullet's per-bullet deque, use [method bullet_homing_check_current_target_type] instead.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_check_has_homing_targets
method.description:
Returns true if the shared deque has any homing targets.
If you want to check if a specific bullet's per-bullet deque has any targets, use [method bullet_check_has_homing_targets] instead.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_check_homing_targets_amount
method.description:
Returns the number of homing targets in the shared deque.
If you want to check the number of targets in a specific bullet's per-bullet deque, use [method bullet_homing_check_targets_amount] instead.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_clear_homing_targets
method.description:
Clears all targets from the shared deque, decrementing mouse counter if applicable. Resets swarm path.
If you want to clear all homing targets from specific bullets' per-bullet deques, use [method all_bullets_clear_homing_targets] or [method bullet_clear_homing_targets] instead.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_get_current_homing_target
method.description:
Returns the current (front) homing target from the shared deque as Variant (Node2D or Vector2; nullptr if invalid/empty).
If you want to get the current target from a specific bullet's per-bullet deque, use [method bullet_get_current_homing_target] instead.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_pop_back_target
method.description:
Pops and returns the back homing target from the shared deque (Variant: Node2D or Vector2; nullptr if invalid/empty).
If you want to pop the back target from a specific bullet's per-bullet deque, use [method bullet_homing_pop_back_target] instead.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_pop_front_target
method.description:
Pops and returns the front (current) homing target from the shared deque (Variant: Node2D target or Vector2; nullptr if invalid/empty).
If you want to pop the front target from a specific bullet's per-bullet deque, use [method bullet_homing_pop_front_target] instead.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_push_back_global_position_target
method.description:
Pushes a global position target to the back of the shared deque.
If you want to push back a target to a specific bullet's per-bullet deque, use [method bullet_homing_push_back_global_position_target] instead.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_push_back_homing_targets_array
method.description:
Pushes an array of homing targets (mix of Node2D and Vector2) to the back of the shared deque.
If you want to push back targets to a specific bullet's per-bullet deque, use [method all_bullets_push_back_homing_targets_array] instead.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_push_back_mouse_position_target
method.description:
Pushes the current mouse global position to the back of the shared deque.
If you want to push back a mouse position target to a specific bullet's per-bullet deque, use [method bullet_homing_push_back_mouse_position_target] instead.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_push_back_node2d_target
method.description:
Pushes a Node2D target to the back of the shared deque.
If you want to push back a target to a specific bullet's per-bullet deque, use [method bullet_homing_push_back_node2d_target] instead.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_push_front_global_position_target
method.description:
Pushes a global position target to the front of the shared deque.
Warning: Pushing to the front changes the current target being followed immediately.
If you want to push front a target to a specific bullet's per-bullet deque, use [method bullet_homing_push_front_global_position_target] instead.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_push_front_homing_targets_array
method.description:
Pushes an array of homing targets to the front of the shared deque.
Warning: Pushing to the front changes the current target being followed immediately.
If you want to push front targets to a specific bullet's per-bullet deque, use [method all_bullets_push_front_homing_targets_array] instead.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_push_front_mouse_position_target
method.description:
Pushes the current mouse global position to the front of the shared deque.
Warning: Pushing to the front changes the current target being followed immediately.
If you want to push front a mouse position target to a specific bullet's per-bullet deque, use [method bullet_homing_push_front_mouse_position_target] instead.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_push_front_node2d_target
method.description:
Pushes a Node2D target to the front of the shared deque.
Warning: Pushing to the front changes the current target being followed immediately.
If you want to push front a target to a specific bullet's per-bullet deque, use [method bullet_homing_push_front_node2d_target] instead.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_replace_homing_targets_with_new_target
method.description:
Clears then pushes a single homing target to the back of the shared deque.
If you want to clear then push a single target to a specific bullet's per-bullet deque, use [method all_bullets_replace_homing_targets_with_new_target] instead.

method.name: shared_homing_deque_replace_homing_targets_with_new_target_array
method.description:
Clears then pushes an array of homing targets to the back of the shared deque.
If you want to clear then push an array of targets to a specific bullet's per-bullet deque, use [method all_bullets_replace_homing_targets_with_new_target_array] instead.

method.name: stop_sprite_animation
method.description: Freezes frame advancement (frozen multimeshes cost one branch per tick).

method.name: teleport_bullet
method.description: Teleports the specified bullet to a new global position.

method.name: teleport_shift_all_bullets
method.description: Shifts the position of all bullets in the specified range by the given offset.

method.name: teleport_shift_bullet
